context: These nodes cover every direct question you can ask Lae'zel after recruiting her into your party. They capture first‑contact, semi‑hostile exchanges: the player can comment on her strange appearance or bring up the shared trauma of being captured, and Lae'zel replies with distance, suspicion, and blunt arrogance. She frequently sneers at the player's looks and at the local "undisciplined" people, stressing githyanki discipline and that she isn't here to make friends. Some branches also handle confrontations with other locals (for example a tiefling who has seen another githyanki), where she may intimidate or demand deference. Certain lines repeat for cinematic purposes; emotionally the tone remains proud, mistrustful, and fearsome.
